import { type OpeningMenuChoice } from './opening-menu.js'
import { openingMenuChoice } from './opening-menu.js'

import { beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { createInGameMenu } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { createSystemMenu } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuChoice } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuDown } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuUp } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuChoice } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuDown } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuUp } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuEnterConfirm } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuEnterSwitch } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuToggleConfirm } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { beginChineseMenuText } from '../../__tests__/menu-text-fixture.js'

const selectionItem = (id: number) => ({ id, label: `i${id}`, disabled: false })
describe('Selection empty single and window bounds', () => {
  it('空表 cursor/pageOffset 均 0', () => {
    const empty = createSelectionMenu([], 8, 5)
    expect(empty).toEqual({ items: [], cursor: 0, pageSize: 8, pageOffset: 0 })
  })

  it('单项 defaultCursor 越界 clamp 到 0', () => {
    const single = createSelectionMenu([selectionItem(7)], 8, 5)
    expect(single.cursor).toBe(0)
    expect(single.pageOffset).toBe(0)
  })

  it('建表和移动不改写借用的 items 数组', () => {
    const items = [selectionItem(1), selectionItem(2)]
    const snapshot = structuredClone(items)
    const s = createSelectionMenu(items, 8, 1)
    moveSelectionDown(s)
    expect(items).toEqual(snapshot)
  })

  it('跨 page 移动：cursor 越界即推进 pageOffset；窗口内回落不动 offset', () => {
    // pageSize 3，8项；跨窗口下边界推进offset，窗口内回移不主动回滚。
    const items = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((id) => ({ id, label: `i${id}` }))
    const s = createSelectionMenu(items, 3, 0)
    expect(s.pageOffset).toBe(0)
    s.cursor = 2
    moveSelectionDown(s)
    expect(s.cursor).toBe(3)
    expect(s.pageOffset).toBe(1) // 跨页后 offset 推进
    s.cursor = 3
    moveSelectionUp(s)
    expect(s.cursor).toBe(2)
    expect(s.pageOffset).toBe(1) // cursor 2 仍在 [1,4) 视窗内 → offset 不主动回落
  })
})

        { id: 2, label: 'b' },

      8,
      -3,

  })

  it('空菜单 getSelected 返回 undefined', () => {
    expect(getSelected(createSelectionMenu([]))).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('primitive 透传 rightText 不消费：getSelected 返回同一 item 对象（identity）', () => {
    const items: SelectionMenuItem[] = [
      { id: 1, label: '草药', rightText: '×3' },
      { id: 2, label: '木剑', rightText: '×1' },
    ]
    const s = createSelectionMenu(items, 8)
    expect(s.items).toBe(items) // 不复制数组
    expect(getSelected(s)).toBe(items[0]) // 同一对象引用
    expect(getSelected(s)?.rightText).toBe('×3') // primitive 层不解析 rightText
  })
})

import { moveSelectionUp } from './primitives.js'

import { createOpeningMenu } from './opening-menu.js'
import { type OpeningMenuChoice } from './opening-menu.js'
import { openingMenuChoice } from './opening-menu.js'
import { openingMenuDown } from './opening-menu.js'
import { openingMenuLabels } from './opening-menu.js'
import { openingMenuUp } from './opening-menu.js'
import { afterEach } from 'vitest'
import { setWordTable } from '../word-lookup.js'
import { beforeEach } from 'vitest'
import { createInGameMenu } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { createSystemMenu } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuChoice } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuDown } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuUp } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuChoice } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuDown } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuUp } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuEnterConfirm } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuEnterSwitch } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuToggleConfirm } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { beginChineseMenuText } from '../../__tests__/menu-text-fixture.js'

const selectionItem = (id: number) => ({ id, label: `i${id}`, disabled: false })
let releaseMenuText: (() => void) | undefined
beforeEach(() => {
  releaseMenuText = beginChineseMenuText()
})
afterEach(() => {
  releaseMenuText?.()
  releaseMenuText = undefined
})
describe('System menu phases and choice identities', () => {
  it('EnterConfirm 重置已有 Yes；ToggleConfirm 在否/是之间切换', () => {
    const s = createSystemMenu()
    expect(s.phase).toBe('menu')
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(false)
    systemMenuToggleConfirm(s)
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(true)
    systemMenuEnterConfirm(s)
    expect(s.phase).toBe('confirm')
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(false) // 默认 否
    systemMenuToggleConfirm(s)
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(true)
    systemMenuToggleConfirm(s)
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(false)
  })

  it('EnterSwitch 按当前音频开关初始化目标和高亮', () => {
    const s = createSystemMenu()
    systemMenuEnterSwitch(s, 'music', true)
    expect(s.phase).toBe('switch')
    expect(s.switchTarget).toBe('music')
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(true) // 当前开 → 高亮 开
    systemMenuEnterSwitch(s, 'sound', false)
    expect(s.phase).toBe('switch')
    expect(s.switchTarget).toBe('sound')
    expect(s.confirmYes).toBe(false) // 当前关 → 高亮 关
  })

  it('systemMenuChoice 按 label id 映射 choice，不按数组位置猜测', () => {
    const s = createSystemMenu()
    // 公开 state 的防御输入：重排已有合法菜单项，区分 WORD id 与 cursor；
    // 生产 factory 仍使用固定顺序，本例不声称产品允许用户重排菜单。
    s.selection.items.reverse()
    expect(systemMenuChoice(s)).toBe('quit')
    s.selection.cursor = 1
    expect(systemMenuChoice(s)).toBe('sound')
  })
})

import { createSystemMenu } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuChoice } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { inGameMenuDown } from './in-game-menu.js'

import { systemMenuUp } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuEnterConfirm } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuEnterSwitch } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { systemMenuToggleConfirm } from './in-game-menu.js'
import { beginChineseMenuText } from '../../__tests__/menu-text-fixture.js'

const selectionItem = (id: number) => ({ id, label: `i${id}`, disabled: false })
let releaseMenuText: (() => void) | undefined
beforeEach(() => {
  releaseMenuText = beginChineseMenuText()
})
afterEach(() => {
  releaseMenuText?.()
  releaseMenuText = undefined
})
describe('Menu cursor boundaries', () => {
  it('cursor 0 Up → 末项 system；末项 Down → 0 status', () => {
    const s = createInGameMenu()
    inGameMenuUp(s)
    expect(s.selection.cursor).toBe(3)
    expect(inGameMenuChoice(s)).toBe('system')
    inGameMenuDown(s)
    expect(s.selection.cursor).toBe(0)
    expect(inGameMenuChoice(s)).toBe('status')
  })

  it('负 defaultCursor 防御归 0（不作为生产记忆游标的合法域证据）', () => {
    expect(createInGameMenu(-1).selection.cursor).toBe(0)
    expect(createSystemMenu(-1).selection.cursor).toBe(0)
  })
})

describe('System menu wrapping and words', () => {
  it('cursor 0 Up → quit；quit Down → save（5 项环绕）', () => {
    const s = createSystemMenu()
    systemMenuUp(s)
    expect(s.selection.cursor).toBe(4)
    expect(systemMenuChoice(s)).toBe('quit')
    systemMenuDown(s)
    expect(s.selection.cursor).toBe(0)
    expect(systemMenuChoice(s)).toBe('save')
  })

  it('defaultCursor 越上界 → 归 0（守卫分支；词表断言在下一条）', () => {
    expect(createSystemMenu(99).selection.cursor).toBe(0)
  })

  it('SystemMenu 词表载入取 flat[11..15] 文案', () => {
    const flat: string[] = []
    flat[11] = '存档X'
    flat[12] = '读档X'
    flat[13] = '音乐X'
    flat[14] = '音效X'
    flat[15] = '退出X'
    setWordTable(flat)
    const s = createSystemMenu()
    expect(s.selection.items.map((it) => it.label)).toEqual([
      '存档X',
      '读档X',
      '音乐X',
      '音效X',
      '退出X',
    ])
  })
})
